Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet for Echoes of Dante, Organic Sci-Fi R3 painterly 2D isometric action RPG. Reference1 defines the ERUDITE identity: SAME recognizable person, face, skin, build and hair, blue-grey short-sleeve field shirt with small chest emblem, blue work trousers with knee pads, brown leather tactical belt and pouches, brown boots, black gloves. Reference2 ONLY defines the profession instrument; do NOT copy its face, hair, clothes or body. Original art compatible with our existing environment.
Create EXACTLY 8 columns x 6 rows = 48 SEPARATE COMPLETE HUMAN FIGURES, equal regular cells, landscape 4:3 sheet exactly 1536x1152 (every cell 192x192), transparent alpha. NO floor, shadows, text, gridlines, loose fragments or limbs. Keep all figures/instruments entirely inside cells with generous margins. Same camera, scale, proportions and lighting in every cell. No collage or separable heads/arms.
Every row, columns face: S/front, SE/right-front, E/right-profile, NE/right-back, N/back, NW/left-back, W/left-profile, SW/left-front.
Rows: 1 idle ready; 2 grounded WALK left-foot contact/right leg trailing; 3 passing right knee past planted left sole; 4 right-foot contact/left leg trailing; 5 passing left knee past planted right sole; 6 compact profession action aimed in that column's facing. Four REAL different walking phases, natural low stride, no running/high knees or copied idle. Both feet visible and same baseline. No enlarged attack pose, giant leap or changed torso size. Top-left soft light, textured fabric/leather/metal, muted warm skin and clear volumes readable at gameplay size. No microdetail, white edges, baked trails or particles. Blue/silver accents (cool blue lights, brushed silver metal) must read as the Erudite palette.
REMOVE the original profession instrument from Reference1 (the brass casting gauntlet) unless the instrument below says to keep it.

WARRIOR (Galactic Warrior): one compact ONE-HANDED energy saber in the dominant right hand: dark-metal hilt with a short, contained energy blade about forearm length plus a hand. The blade MUST be thick (about 3 px wide at sprite scale), saturated electric cyan-blue (#1FA8FF) glowing with a bright white-blue core, clearly BLUE in every direction and every row, never plain white, silver or grey, never a thin knife or dagger. Painted as a solid physical object, NOT a long beam. Idle/walk: blade lowered and angled down-forward, close to the body. Action: a restrained arc strike aimed in the facing direction, blade clearly attached to the fist, other arm balancing. No baked slash trail, glow cloud, sparks or particles. Not a sword, staff, gun or spear.
EQUIPMENT none (clothes only): the base blue-grey field shirt, blue trousers with knee pads, brown belt, pouches, boots and gloves exactly as Reference1 'none'. No armor plates, no helmet. Original brass forearm bracers may remain only where they do not collide with the instrument.
FEMALE ERUDITA. Match Reference1: dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, original female face and athletic female build. COLOURS: keep Reference1's palette exactly: blue-grey shirt (not dark grey, not black), mid-blue trousers, brown belt/boots; do not darken or desaturate the figure.
